findings.problem: Selected Ice Shot keeps physical-only mana-leech eligibility; Oisin requires elemental instead of physical.

game_evidence.verified_text: Mana Leech from Supported Skills recovers based on Elemental Damage Types instead of Physical Damage

causal_proof: Enabled Oisin is in selected group 3; Ice Shot has Attack and passes the retained type gate. Its spell tag is not an exclusivity restriction.
Cached applied ring grants PhysicalDamageManaLeech BASE 8.7; mana is positive and no CannotLeechMana/CannotGainMana restriction is present in the cached lines.

Cached hit has positive Physical 9732.511165133, Lightning 26506.898260381502, Cold 60671.4342589555 and Fire 17726.923460505503 averages. These are baseline observations, not recalculated current values.
The native stat is unmapped/unknown_mod_name. Extracted mapping requests ManaLeechBasedOnElementalDamage plus Condition:NoManaLeechFromPhysicalDamage; the flag whitelist rejects them.

Current leech_percent already knows how to extend the physical percentage to elemental types but contains no Oisin physical-exclusion consumer. It therefore still funds leech from physical instead of elemental damage.

Existing per-hit recovery output consumes the typed leech instance amount. Its amount is not capped by the mana rate ceiling, so rate saturation is not a valid reason to call the source-type error effectless.
findings.wrong_existing_output: ManaLeechGainPerHit / typed mana-leech amount. Exact current value and sustained ManaLeechGainRate delta not measured; capped rates may remain unchanged.
findings.smallest_existing_path: Translate the native Oisin stat into existing typed leech eligibility and consume the physical exclusion in leech_percent. Merely admitting the elemental-extension flag would incorrectly keep physical leech too. Preserve attack restrictions, the existing whole-hit ceiling and recovery conventions.
findings.other_coverage: 15 other imported support groups are unselected; no selected-output defect established for those hosts.
findings.measurement_status: Source-proven using retained static inputs; no new calculation or current-head numerical delta.

findings.problem: Compatible Brutality III numeric physical MORE is admitted, while its no-elemental/no-chaos flags are rejected; forbidden damage survives existing actor output paths.
causal_proof: warbringer-01 selected Shield Wall is Attack, has enabled Brutality III, and the cached ledger applies its PhysicalDamage MORE 30 to TotalHitAvg.

The same cache rejects both restriction stats as unknown_mod_name yet reports Fire average 47216.2222035 in the selected hit and IgniteDPS 4989.044168218. Fire damage must be zero with this support. Exact current DPS/ignite delta is not asserted.

disciple-of-varashta-02 enabled Warrior and Reaver gem groups contain Brutality III and have computed MinionMeleeStep rows. The retained skill type includes Attack. Current minion_skill_modifiers judges and maps each compatible support through the same flag translator.

That build has applied Entropic Incarnation node 30720: minions gain 10% of physical damage as chaos. Current mapper rejects DealNoChaos; the existing damage gate therefore cannot remove this granted chaos component. This establishes a second build with affected actor DPS without assuming an event or an unused skill.
The shared typed damage gate already consumes DealNoFire/Cold/Lightning/Chaos after conversion; the restrictions are missing at translation, not an absent damage simulation.
findings.wrong_existing_output: warbringer-01 selected elemental hit damage and damage-derived outputs; disciple-of-varashta-02 linked Warrior/Reaver DPS includes forbidden gained chaos.
findings.smallest_existing_path: Admit the four already-consumed DealNo<Type> flag names or add equivalent native stat translation, through the shared support mapping used by player and minion actors.

separate_unverified_subcase.reason: 20% chance is also rejected; current offence code explicitly lacks this probabilistic reduction branch. A concrete positive-mitigation contribution for these actor outputs was not established from retained decompositions. Do not infer an exact DPS correction or bundle a larger model into the proven flag fix.

findings.other_coverage: Nine support groups outside the affected player/minion actors remain unselected. Three additional diagnostic carriers (lich-03, witchhunter-04, witchhunter-07) expose restrictions from other skills, not their selected main skill.
findings.measurement_status: Player fire leakage is directly visible in the 45a3 cache. Minion chaos leakage is source-proven from applied passive plus eligible support; cached minion rows lack type decomposition, so numerical magnitude remains unverified.

game_evidence.verified_text: Supported Skills have twice as many Cooldown Uses

causal_proof: The full 230 scan finds 57 groups across 51 builds; exactly two are selected main groups: pathfinder-02 and tactician-07.

Both caches select ConvalescencePlayer, the persistent reservation effect. Its retained types are Buff/OngoingSkill/HasReservation/Persistent/ReserveInAllSets/AttackInPlace; it has neither required cooldown type.

No support in those two groups adds a cooldown type. Current fixed-point support judgement therefore rejects Second Wind II for the selected reservation effect. The cache has cooldown 0 and action rate 0, with no Second Wind stat diagnostics on these selected effects.
ConvalescenceActivePlayer is separately granted by the gem, has Cooldown and a 30000 ms cooldown with one stored use, but it is not the selected effect in either build. Do not silently substitute it.

The five cached double-use diagnostics belong to unselected Frost Bomb (chronomancer-06) or Infernal Cry (titan-01, titan-05, witchhunter-06, witchhunter-10). The Witchhunter Frostbolt cooldown does not make the Infernal Cry support local to Frostbolt.
findings.retained_model_limit: The native double-use stat is unknown and calc_cooldown only adds AdditionalCooldownUses. This remains a real unsupported capability for an eligible selected skill; it is not globally effectless.
findings.bounded_clearance: No eligible selected actor with a demonstrated wrong stored-use output exists in this full230 input set. Do not implement from occurrence count alone. No recharge timeline, burst usage, or new configuration inferred.
findings.separate_deferred_subcase: Second Wind III restore-life-on-use is an event-based stat outside this capacity lead; its chronomancer-06 diagnostic is retained but not promoted to a defect.

coverage_method: Read every frozen full230 cache and decode every corresponding retained code.txt. Partition all enabled active-skill-set groups containing these three support families by cached zero-based selected group, then include computed minion actors belonging to Brutality groups. No top-N filtering. Other features, sets and holdout were not inspected.
